attempts.summary: Configured node1 as a VLAN-segmenting switch: eth1 (link to node2) is an untagged access port on VLAN 50, eth2 (link to node3) is an untagged access port on VLAN 60, implemented via a vlan-filtering Linux bridge (br-access) with per-VLAN SVIs (br-access.50=192.168.50.1, br-access.60=192.168.60.1). node2 (192.168.50.2) and node3 (192.168.60.3) each keep a working link to node1 in their own VLAN, but cannot reach each other (separate broadcast domains plus IPv4 forwarding disabled on node1). Configuration persisted via a systemd oneshot unit (vlan-access.service) + sysctl.d entry on node1, and NetworkManager connection profiles on node2/node3. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of VLAN config and connectivity.
